cases.name: group_having_window
cases.sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC) AS sales_rank, SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER () AS retained_total FROM sales GROUP BY region HAVING SUM(amount) >= 300 ORDER BY sales_rank, region

cases.name: window_then_distinct
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT SUM(amount) AS total, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(amount)) AS sales_rank FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY total
